upstreams.name: web-design-guidelines
upstreams.command: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines --agent codex

notes: The Impeccable npm wrapper version and native engine version are separate release versions.

The initial optional binary download was unavailable; the matching published @impeccable/cli-linux-x64@0.1.18 npm package was installed under /tmp and passed as IMPECCABLE_BIN to the exact requested command. The installer then verified and installed its own engine in the project.
Codex project skill folder is .agents/skills. No global skill or hook configuration was installed.
Upstream commit comparison proves the installed SKILL.md bytes match those files at the recorded commits; it is not a claim that every distribution file was built from that commit.
